history.administration_response: Substantiating evidence showing that the functions from UNSOS had been fully transferred as at 1 July 2016, as well as that national staff administration functions had been transferred to the Regional Service Centre in Entebbe from its client missions as at 1 July 2016, was provided to the Board under separate cover.
history.board_assessment: While some functions were retained by the missions (in particular, check- in/check-out and cashier functions), most have been transferred. The Board closes this recommendation.
